blocks.explanation:
Left side ko ghaur se dekhein: \(\cos A\cos B + \sin A\sin B\) ka pattern hai.
Yeh bilkul \(\cos(A - B)\) hai, yani fundamental law. Expand karne ki zaroorat hi nahi.
Plan: \(A = 60^{\circ} + \theta\), \(B = 60^{\circ} - \theta\) le kar \(A - B\) simplify karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: ek identity.
Saabit karna hai: L.H.S. \(= \cos 2\theta\).
Tareeqa:
\[\cos A\cos B + \sin A\sin B = \cos(A - B)\]
jahan \(A = 60^{\circ} + \theta\), \(B = 60^{\circ} - \theta\). Formula ko ulta (expanded se compact) pehchanna sab se chhota raasta hai; har bracket ko alag kholte to bohat lamba kaam ho jata.

Pattern pehchanein
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos\big[(60^{\circ} + \theta) - (60^{\circ} - \theta)\big]\]
Kyun: \"cos cos plus sin sin\" hamesha difference ka cosine hota hai. Pehle cos mein jo angle hai woh A, doosre mein jo hai woh B.

Angle simplify karein
\[(60^{\circ} + \theta) - (60^{\circ} - \theta) = 2\theta\]
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos 2\theta = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: Bracket kholte waqt minus andar jata hai: \(60^{\circ} + \theta - 60^{\circ} + \theta = 2\theta\).
Dhyan dein: \(-(60^{\circ} - \theta)\) mein \(\theta\) ka sign plus ho jata hai; isay \(-\theta\) likhne se jawab 0 aa jayega jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\cos 90^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} + \sin 90^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ} = 0 + \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\cos 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono sides aadha aayin.
